Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1054505. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno to require structures, and filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054505'. Keep every activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
